reuse.reason: The official selector has no per-model unavailable state. The complete pinned browser fork preserves the Model / Effort menu, search, projections and provider ordering, adds visible disabled deployment capabilities, and rechecks the latest catalog at the shared composer and /model submission boundary. The command popup receives disabled/disabledReason through the separately tracked ui-commands compatibility fork. The existing official Effort row follows the Host catalog: off/low/high/max are selectable when execution supports them, while unavailable providers remain visible and disabled with eight-language explanations. The shared directory rechecks current capabilities before RPC. The Host-only sessionModelCatalog seam supplies each Session binding its effective owner/Session provider selection. Catalog caches are isolated by binding and invalidated on the existing provider/settings/credentials and connection events; the account-scoped official zero-argument RPC is unchanged.
gaps: The official selector is extended with explicit per-model and per-reasoning availability metadata. Unsupported provider capabilities remain visible and disabled; supported effort selection preserves the original official interaction.

The pinned official model catalog is Host-global. This fork adapts only its data lifetime to one catalog per Session binding, retaining the official menu, scope and projection contract; Session overrides cannot contaminate another Session or the account settings catalog.

Workers cannot run Agent Teams. The official TeamModeToggle component (not exported by /client) shows the real root/child Session rules and a locked, off switch with a localized explanation. An active official service takes precedence in the same slot. No team state or remote execution service is registered.
